ca51c81bb6084c.s: Palle Panduga, announced at the launch of Amarajeevi Jaladhara, covers works worth ₹11,085 crore in which area?
ca51c81bb6084c.x: Palle Panduga concerns rural infrastructure works worth ₹11,085 crore. Irrigation (36 projects, ₹35,000 crore) and Godavari–Krishna–Cauvery interlinking were separate announcements.

caad09cf63ec10.s: Under the Sanjeevani tribal programme, an emergency network of how many vehicles is planned in Alluri Sitarama Raju district?
caad09cf63ec10.x: The Sanjeevani programme plans an emergency network of 150 vehicles in Alluri Sitarama Raju district.

cad90eb3518b84.s: Under the Sanjeevani tribal programme, the 104 ambulances provide mobile services with how many diagnostic tests?
cad90eb3518b84.x: The 104 ambulances provide mobile health services with 42 diagnostic tests; Talli Bidda Express is the separate transport service for pregnant women.

ca8e80ad5e3b38.s: THOTA, the parent law of the Andhra Pradesh Human Organ Transplantation Amendment Act 2026, was enacted in:
ca8e80ad5e3b38.x: The Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act (THOTA) was enacted in 1994 and amended in 2011.

cac0ceffba746d.s: The revamped Sri Venkateswara Museum at Tirumala includes a 3D model of:
cac0ceffba746d.x: The museum has a 3D model of the Seven Hills, along with Sri Krishnadevaraya's jewellery and Annamacharya's instruments; there is no Eastern Ghats model.

ca51b30428fea1.s: Under the proposed GPS-based fishing boundary system for Pulicat Lake, which body will fix the digital coordinates?
ca51b30428fea1.x: The National Centre for Coastal Research (NCCR) will fix the digital coordinates; alerts go to Marine Police control rooms in Tiruvallur and Tirupati.

cnaedb7e7093ef.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 'Swayam AP' brand of Andhra Pradesh?
o: It markets products of DWCRA women.
Its outlets are in Vijayawada and Tirupati.
It was launched on 14 October 2026 at the Undavalli camp office.
cnaedb7e7093ef.x: The Swayam AP outlets are in Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam, not Tirupati; the other statements are correct.

cn7680d5c14bf9.s: Under Andhra Pradesh's Trauma Registry, Pre-Hospital Notification to hospitals is made by staff of which ambulances?
cn7680d5c14bf9.x: Pre-Hospital Notification is made by 108/104 ambulance staff, who alert hospitals in advance; 112 and 100 are not the notifying services.

cna0c61b28dce7.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's committee on uniform college affiliation (27 October 2026)?
o: It has to submit its report within three months.
It will study the practices of Maharashtra, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Uttar Pradesh.
The Commissioner of Higher Education is its convener.
It is headed by the APSCHE Chairman.
cna0c61b28dce7.x: The committee has to report within one month, not three months; the other statements are correct.

cn246739992950.s: In Andhra Pradesh's uniform college affiliation committee (October 2026), which university is represented by its Vice-Chancellor?
cn246739992950.x: Andhra University is represented by its VC; Sri Venkateswara University, Krishna University and JNTU Anantapur are represented by their Registrars.

cn29700eab323a.s: FSSAI, which oversees food safety rules such as Andhra Pradesh's ban on artificial paneer, works under which Union Ministry?
cn29700eab323a.x: FSSAI, set up under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, works under the Union Health Ministry, not the Ministry of Consumer Affairs.

ca0619c709b3ca.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Nethannala Sevalo scheme?
o: It was launched on the 12th National Handloom Day, 7 August 2026.
62,541 is the number of handloom families getting free power.
It gives ₹25,000 a year to 62,541 loom-owning families.
It was launched in Chirala constituency of Bapatla district.
ca0619c709b3ca.x: 62,541 is the figure for free handloom power, not for the ₹25,000 support, which went to 71,536 families; the other statements are correct.

ca5101a78cd6b8.s: Under the Andhra Pradesh School Education Department's Canva MoU, free Canva for Education is provided in how many phases?
ca5101a78cd6b8.x: The Canva MoU provides free Canva for Education to students, teachers and officials in four phases.

cabf40c3a570a6.s: Besides Amaravati, the Andhra Pradesh–United Kingdom MoU on urban development (August 2026) covers how many urban local bodies?
cabf40c3a570a6.x: The AP–UK MoU covers urban development of Amaravati and all 123 urban local bodies.

cabcac71f8275a.s: Under the Swarna Andhra @2047 Vision, the 'Unique Skill Passport' belongs to which guiding principle?
cabcac71f8275a.x: The Unique Skill Passport is part of Population Management & HRD; it is not one of the governance tools (RTG, AI analytics, AWARE).

ca87a10f749adf.s: Mee Mart in Andhra Pradesh modernises fair price shops into:
ca87a10f749adf.x: Mee Mart modernises fair price shops into community retail centres; it does not replace the Public Distribution System.

ca63bb48ca28b7.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Sanjeevani digital health project and ABDM?
o: The National Health Authority is the agency for ABDM.
The Sanjeevani project was piloted in Kuppam.
The Sanjeevani technical committee has 14 members.
ca63bb48ca28b7.x: ABDM was launched in 2021, not 2022; the Sanjeevani committee that selects the implementing agency has 14 members.

ca733cc5407b6c.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's State-Level Council monitoring VB-G RAM G?
o: The Deputy Chief Minister chairs the Council.
It meets at least twice a year.
Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan is its vice-chair.
ca733cc5407b6c.x: CM Chandrababu Naidu chairs the Council; Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan is only the vice-chair.

cae385538aebb1.s: Which agency implements Andhra Pradesh's urban crèche initiative?
cae385538aebb1.x: MEPMA, under the Municipal Administration Department, implements the urban crèches; Mobile Crèches is the technical-support partner.

cacf1d2d980f2a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Amaravati educational and cultural academy at Abburaajupalem?
o: It is developed by the DAV Amaravati Rythu Vidyalaya Vedantam Group.
It is implemented under the AP School Education Corporation.
It is on a 3-acre site near the E3–N14 Junction.
It is being built at a cost of ₹25 crore.
cacf1d2d980f2a.x: The academy is not under the AP School Education Corporation; it is developed by a group of Thullur Mandal farmers on a 3-acre site.

ca7360f32f67be.s: UN-Habitat, which signed an urban development MoU with Andhra Pradesh in July 2026, is headquartered at:
ca7360f32f67be.x: UN-Habitat is headquartered in Nairobi; the MoU provides for a Centre of Excellence for Urban Affairs in Amaravati.

ca210989ce187e.s: Bedford School's proposed Amaravati campus will be the school's:
ca210989ce187e.x: The Amaravati campus is Bedford School's third international campus and the first foreign educational institution in Amaravati.

n89c4475133c.s: The four higher-education Bills introduced in Andhra Pradesh in August 2026 converted the Regulatory Commission into a:
n89c4475133c.x: The Bills turned the Regulatory Commission into a fee-regulation committee and reduced the land requirement for private universities.

cac1a6df248f14.s: Pashu Samvardhaka Margadarshini, launched by Minister K. Atchannaidu for dairy farmers, is a:
cac1a6df248f14.x: Pashu Samvardhaka Margadarshini is a livestock e-magazine on animal health, breeding and schemes that reaches about 25 lakh dairy farmers.

cac2af420c827a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about electronic service of court processes?
o: During COVID-19, the Supreme Court allowed service through email, WhatsApp, Telegram and Signal.
The AP Electronic Processes Rules, 2025 were made by the AP High Court.
Under the AP Electronic Processes Rules, 2025, physical service is fully discontinued.
The IT Act, 2000 gives legal recognition to electronic records and signatures.
cac2af420c827a.x: Under the AP rules, physical service continues wherever e-service fails, so it is not discontinued; the other statements are correct.

ca1fcecf151d0e.s: The UDAY scheme in the power sector concerns:
ca1fcecf151d0e.x: UDAY concerns State takeover of DISCOM debt; rooftop solar is Rooftop Solar Programme Phase II, connections are Saubhagya and solar pumps are PM-KUSUM.

ca460a9ddae0bb.s: Which Article provides that no person shall be excluded from the electoral rolls on the ground of sex?
ca460a9ddae0bb.x: Article 325 bars exclusion from electoral rolls on the ground of sex; Article 326 provides universal adult franchise.

caaf766e61be9b.s: Lok Sabha seats are allotted to States on the basis of their:
caaf766e61be9b.x: Lok Sabha seats are based on population, not area, which is why southern States fear losing seats in delimitation.

ca8a0609930e5b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about vehicle systems and the Nellore Intelligent Traffic Management System?
o: The Nellore system uses SARATHI for vehicle registration.
The Nellore system uses ANPR linked to VAHAN.
ca8a0609930e5b.x: SARATHI is for driving licences, not vehicle registration; the Nellore system uses ANPR linked to VAHAN.

ca2a3664af2550.s: Which component of Andhra Pradesh's draft Population Management Policy 2026 deals with elderly care?
ca2a3664af2550.x: Kshema is elderly care; Matrutva is maternal health, Shakti women's workforce participation and Naipunyam skills and healthcare workers.

caa7ac24a81513.s: Equal property rights for women in Andhra Pradesh were introduced under which Chief Minister?
caa7ac24a81513.x: Equal property rights for women in AP were introduced earlier under N. T. Rama Rao, not by a recent constitutional amendment.

caf5ef81535b27.s: In Andhra Pradesh's Operation Clean Sweep, Week 2 focused on:
o: Public toilets and garbage vulnerable points
Desilting storm water drains, nallas and backlanes
Source segregation and bulk waste generators
caf5ef81535b27.x: Week 2 was desilting drains, nallas and backlanes; Week 1 was black spots and roads, Week 3 source segregation and Week 4 public toilets.

ca808844d8452e.s: The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 expanded the recognised disability categories from 7 to:
ca808844d8452e.x: The RPwD Act, 2016 expanded the recognised categories from 7 to 21.

cac89164422e80.s: Which case is associated with the right to education under Article 21?
cac89164422e80.x: Mohini Jain (1992) relates to the right to education; Maneka Gandhi required a just, fair and reasonable procedure.

cae1b2d6005cb8.s: Which case linked the right to a clean environment with Article 21?
o: Maneka Gandhi v Union of India
cae1b2d6005cb8.x: Subhash Kumar v Bihar linked a clean environment with Article 21 (the original dates did not support a sequence question).

cabc264a3ad865.s: Which Article relates to the State Election Commission's conduct of municipal elections?
cabc264a3ad865.x: Article 243ZA covers municipal elections, while Article 243K covers Panchayat elections by the State Election Commission.

ca4f0cb2f0d071.s: Under the 'Water Bell' policy for MGNREGS worksites in Andhra Pradesh, workers get drinking water:
ca4f0cb2f0d071.x: The Water Bell policy provides drinking water to workers every hour at worksites; AP also ranked first in MGNREGS social audits in 2025–26.

ca8c1aaf8f4776.s: NITI Aayog's Aspirational Districts Programme was launched in:
ca8c1aaf8f4776.x: The Aspirational Districts Programme was launched in 2018, with NITI Aayog as its nodal agency.

cac245fb09732a.s: MGNREGA, enacted in 2005, was implemented in:
cac245fb09732a.x: MGNREGA was enacted in 2005 but implemented in 2006; social audits under it are mandatory.

caa1470e3fbdf0.s: The stated range of the Lithium Iron Phosphate batteries used in electric buses is:
caa1470e3fbdf0.x: LFP batteries, noted for thermal stability, have a stated range of 150–300 km.

ca9b829994897f.s: Which of the following is true of the Divyang Shakti Scheme of Andhra Pradesh?
ca9b829994897f.x: Divyang Shakti gives free RTC bus travel to differently-abled persons on urban and rural services, and helpers may accompany them.

ca40472510b0b8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about heat stress in cattle and Andhra Pradesh's summer advisory?
o: Community water troughs are recommended in villages.
Indigenous breeds are more vulnerable to heat stress than crossbred animals.
Clean drinking water should be available through the day.
Crossbred and high-yield dairy animals are more vulnerable to heat stress.
ca40472510b0b8.x: Crossbred and high-yield animals are more vulnerable than indigenous breeds, so the statement about indigenous breeds is wrong.

cad05db32b2e5f.s: Andhra Pradesh's summer advisory for protecting cattle from heat stress recommends sheds in which orientation?
cad05db32b2e5f.x: The advisory recommends sheds in an east–west orientation, not north–south.

ca4070d727fefb.s: Coringa Wildlife Sanctuary in the Godavari estuary is India's second-largest mangrove forest after:
ca4070d727fefb.x: Coringa is India's second-largest mangrove forest after the Sundarbans.

new.s: Amarajeevi Jaladhara, Andhra Pradesh's Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0 programme, adopts a water norm of how many litres per person per day?
new.x: Amarajeevi Jaladhara provides household tap connections at 55 litres per person per day.

new.s: At the Amarajeevi Jaladhara launch, an investment of ₹1 lakh crore was announced for:
new.x: ₹1 lakh crore is for the Rayalaseema Horticulture Hub; Palle Panduga is ₹11,085 crore and the 36 irrigation projects ₹35,000 crore.

new.s: What housing target was announced at the Amarajeevi Jaladhara launch at Proddatur in October 2026?
new.x: The launch announced a target of 19 lakh houses by 2029.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Amarajeevi Jaladhara:
1. It was launched at Proddatur in YSR Kadapa district.
2. Its focus is urban households.
3. It covers about 90 lakh households.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. The programme focuses on rural habitations, not urban households.

new.s: How much did Andhra Pradesh release for NTR Bharosa social security pensions for October 2026?
new.x: ₹2,692.34 crore was released for October 2026 pensions, distributed door to door from 6.30 a.m. on 1 October 2026.

new.s: From 1 October 2026, the Central share of NSAP pensions in Andhra Pradesh is credited to Aadhaar-linked accounts through:
new.x: The Central share of NSAP pensions is credited through SNA-SPARSH to 9.34 lakh beneficiaries; the State share is still paid in cash.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about pension payments in Andhra Pradesh from 1 October 2026:
1. The Central share of NSAP pensions is credited directly to Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.
2. The State share is also credited to bank accounts.
3. About 9.34 lakh beneficiaries get the direct credit.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. The State share is still paid in cash.

new.s: TTD's first-of-its-kind life insurance for pilgrims who die of natural causes in Tirumala gives cover of:
new.x: The new natural-death life cover is ₹2 lakh; ₹10 lakh is the raised accident cover.

new.s: TTD raised the accidental insurance cover for pilgrims from ₹3 lakh to:
new.x: Accidental insurance was raised from ₹3 lakh to ₹10 lakh; ₹2 lakh is the separate natural-death cover.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh's zero poverty programme, P4 stands for:
new.x: P4 is the Public-Private-People Partnership, launched on Ugadi, 30 March 2025.

new.s: Under the P4 model, the top 10% of society adopt the bottom:
new.x: Under P4 the top 10% adopt the bottom 20% through aid, mentoring and resources.

new.s: Under the P4 programme, the beneficiary families are called:
new.x: Beneficiary families are Bangaru Kutumbams (golden families); Margadarsis are the mentors or donors.

new.s: At P4's first anniversary on 30 March 2026, how many Margadarsis had adopted families?
new.x: By 30 March 2026, 1.06 lakh Margadarsis had adopted 10.3 lakh families.

new.s: The 3D concrete-printed government houses at Burripalem are being built under:
new.x: The Burripalem 3D-printed houses come under PMAY-G 2.0 (rural); AP's first-rank award was under PMAY-U 2.0 (urban).

new.s: How many 3D concrete-printed houses are being built in the Burripalem pilot?
new.x: The pilot has 100 houses of 325 sq ft each.

new.s: Which civic body won the State-level Swachh City award at the Swachh Andhra Awards 2026?
new.x: Vijayawada won the State-level Swachh City award on 2 October 2026; Guntur and Mangalagiri-Tadepalli won Swachh Municipality awards.

new.s: The CLAP campaign launched in Andhra Pradesh on 2 October 2021 stands for:
new.x: CLAP is Clean Andhra Pradesh (Jagananna Swachha Sankalpam), launched on Gandhi Jayanti 2021 under Swachh Bharat Mission 2.0.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the 'Swarna Andhra – Swachh Andhra' day is observed on:
o: The second Saturday of every month
The last Saturday of every month
The first Saturday of every month
The third Saturday of every month
new.x: The third Saturday of every month is Swarna Andhra – Swachh Andhra day, run by the Swachha Andhra Corporation.

new.s: World Habitat Day, on which Andhra Pradesh received the PMAY-U 2.0 award, was first observed in:
new.x: World Habitat Day, set by the UNGA for the first Monday of October, was first observed in 1986.

new.s: The Global Mentor Network under the permanent Pan-IIT Council at Amaravati has how many IIT experts?
new.x: The network has 100 IIT experts; ₹500 crore is the size of the Pan-IIT Venture Fund.

new.s: The Andhra Pradesh Omnibus Act–2026 amended the AP Fire Service Act of which year?
new.x: The Omnibus Act amended the Fire Service Act, 1999, the Single Window Clearance Act, 2002 and the Public Service Delivery Guarantee Act, 2017.

new.s: Under the Sanjeevani tribal strategy, coaching for IIT and NEET is to be provided through an agreement with:
new.x: The education component is an agreement with IIT Madras for IIT and NEET coaching.

new.s: Under the Sanjeevani tribal strategy, Adivathalli Bata will build roads of what length?
new.x: Adivathalli Bata covers 900 km of roads at ₹1,000 crore.

new.s: Which scheme is NOT part of the welfare convergence under the Sanjeevani tribal strategy?
new.x: The convergence covers Talliki Vandanam, Annadata Sukhibhava, Stree Shakti and Auto Driver Service; Amma Vodi is not in the list.

new.s: Under the Sanjeevani tribal strategy, coffee cultivation in the Araku region is to be expanded by:
new.x: Coffee is to be expanded by 1 lakh acres, with coffee and pepper as alternative crops.

new.s: G.O. 3, which reserved jobs in tribal areas for locals, was annulled by:
o: The National Commission for Scheduled Tribes
new.x: G.O. 3 was annulled by the Supreme Court; the government will propose a legal alternative.

new.s: Under the AP Human Organ Transplantation Amendment Act 2026, which relatives were added as near relatives?
new.x: The Act adds grandparents and grandchildren as near relatives and recognises swap transplantation.

new.s: The Trauma Registry launched by Andhra Pradesh on 21 October 2026 aims at timely treatment of accident victims during the:
new.x: The Trauma Registry targets treatment in the first hour after an accident, the Golden Hour.

new.s: Of the 32 electric buses flagged off at Tirumala in September 2026, how many were given by Reliance Foundation?
new.x: The 32 e-buses are 25 from Reliance Foundation and 7 from Bharat Biotech.

new.s: Who will handle the operation and maintenance of TTD's biogas plant proposed by IOCL?
new.x: IOCL proposed the plant; O&M is by GPS Renewables at ₹2.80 crore.

new.s: The Pilgrim Experience Centre inaugurated at Tirumala on 16 September 2026 was built at a cost of:
new.x: The Pilgrim Experience Centre at the Vaikuntham Queue Complex cost ₹4 crore.

new.s: In the Pulicat Lake GPS boundary plan, NCCR stands for:
new.x: NCCR is the National Centre for Coastal Research, which will fix the digital coordinates.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about apprenticeship bodies in Andhra Pradesh:
1. The State Apprenticeship Council is chaired by the Director of Employment and Training.
2. NAPS 2.0 comes under the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Only statement 2 is correct. The State Apprenticeship Council is chaired by the Principal Secretary, Skill Development; the Director of Employment and Training chairs the NAPS 2.0 committee.

new.s: How much has the Union Fisheries Ministry sanctioned for the Rayadoruvu sea mouth project near Pulicat?
new.x: The Rayadoruvu sea mouth project gets ₹133.11 crore from the Union Fisheries Ministry.

new.s: How many districts has Andhra Pradesh had since 31 December 2025?
new.x: AP has 28 districts since 31 December 2025, with Polavaram and Markapuram as the new ones.

new.s: Which two new districts were formed in Andhra Pradesh on 31 December 2025?
new.x: Polavaram and Markapuram are the two new districts; 5 new revenue divisions were formed with them.

new.s: The AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Act, 2026 making Amaravati the capital amends which provision of the 2014 Act?
new.x: The 2026 Act (Act 7 of 2026) amends Section 5(2) of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014.

new.s: The AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Act, 2026 has effect from:
new.x: The Act, which got President's assent on 6 April 2026, has effect from 2 June 2024.

new.s: Under the 2026 amendment to the GSWS Act, Grama Sachivalayams in Andhra Pradesh were renamed:
new.x: Village secretariats are now Swarna Gramam and ward secretariats Swarna Ward.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the renaming of village and ward secretariats in Andhra Pradesh?
o: An ordinance of 12 January 2026 amended the GSWS Act, 2023.
The village volunteer system was revived with it.
Ward Sachivalayams were renamed Swarna Ward.
The renaming is linked to Swarna Andhra Vision 2047.
new.x: The volunteer system (about 2.6 lakh volunteers) has not been revived; pensions are distributed by secretariat staff.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about BC reservation in Andhra Pradesh local bodies (October 2026):
1. The High Court struck down G.O.s giving 34% BC reservation in rural local bodies.
2. The Supreme Court upheld the 34% quota on appeal.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Only statement 1 is correct. The Supreme Court dismissed the State's appeal on 9 October 2026, so the quota stays struck down.

new.s: In striking down the 34% BC quota in AP local bodies, the High Court held that total reservation must not exceed:
new.x: The High Court held that total reservation must not exceed 50%.

new.s: From what age do fishermen in Andhra Pradesh become eligible for pension?
new.x: Fishermen in AP get pension from 50 years, besides ₹20,000 fishing-ban assistance.

new.s: Netanna Sevalo's ₹25,000 annual support in 2026 went to how many weaver families?
new.x: ₹25,000 each went to 71,536 families; 62,541 is the free handloom power figure.

new.s: Under Pillale Sampada, the assistance for a fourth child is:
new.x: Pillale Sampada gives ₹30,000 for the third child and ₹40,000 for the fourth.

new.s: How much fishing-ban assistance do fishermen families in Andhra Pradesh receive?
new.x: Fishermen get ₹20,000 as fishing-ban assistance.

new.s: Talliki Vandanam was earlier known as:
new.x: Talliki Vandanam replaced Amma Vodi (January 2020).

new.s: In PM SHRI, the 'SHRI' stands for:
new.x: PM SHRI = Prime Minister's Schools for Rising India: model government schools aligned with NEP 2020.

new.s: Prashast 2.0, used in Andhra Pradesh schools, screens for how many types of disabilities?
new.x: Prashast 2.0 screens 21 types of disabilities and is integrated with UDISE+.

new.s: Bedford School's first campus in India is located at:
new.x: Bedford's first India campus is at Mohali; the Amaravati campus is the first foreign institution in Amaravati.

new.s: Under Talliki Vandanam, what is the monthly income ceiling for urban families?
new.x: Eligibility is income below ₹10,000/month in rural areas and below ₹12,000/month in urban areas.

new.s: In 2026, the Food Planet Prize won by APCNF was presented at:
new.x: The prize was presented at Båstad, Sweden, on 2 June 2026.

new.s: How much per acre does Telangana's Rythu Bharosa give, in contrast to AP's ₹20,000 per farmer under Annadata Sukhibhava?
new.x: Telangana Rythu Bharosa is ₹12,000 per acre; AP's Annadata Sukhibhava is ₹20,000 per farmer.

new.s: Under NTR Pension Bharosa, how much do weavers in Andhra Pradesh receive per month?
new.x: About 85,000 weavers get ₹4,000 a month under NTR Pension Bharosa.

new.s: Free power for handloom families in Andhra Pradesh is up to how many units a month?
new.x: Handloom families get up to 200 units a month; powerlooms get up to 500 units.

new.s: MEPMA, the implementing agency of Andhra Pradesh's urban crèches, stands for:
o: Municipal Elimination of Poverty Mission Authority
Mission for Elimination of Poverty in Municipal Areas
Mission for Empowerment of Poor in Metropolitan Areas
Municipal Employment and Poverty Mitigation Agency
new.x: MEPMA = Mission for Elimination of Poverty in Municipal Areas, under the Municipal Administration Department.

new.s: Where was the Sanjeevani AI-based digital health project of Andhra Pradesh piloted?
new.x: Sanjeevani was piloted in Kuppam and is to be expanded statewide.

new.s: Which body is Mee Mart's partner in modernising fair price shops in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Mee Mart is run with NCCF; the first outlet opened at Lalupuram near Guntur.

new.s: Kalyana Lakshmi, which gives low-interest loans for marriage expenses of SHG families, runs under:
new.x: Kalyana Lakshmi is under Stree Nidhi.

new.s: The Shakti programme strengthens Gram Sabhas in Andhra Pradesh under which Act?
new.x: Shakti strengthens Gram Sabhas under the PESA Act, 1996, with committees having 50% women.

new.s: Under the JJM 2.0 O&M plan in Andhra Pradesh, the first annual plan has to be prepared within:
new.x: The first annual plan is due within 90 days and the next by 31 March.

new.s: Of Andhra Pradesh's 123 urban local bodies, how many held elections in 2021?
new.x: Only 100 ULBs polled in 2021; 23 were held up by court cases.

new.s: EAGLE, Andhra Pradesh's anti-narcotics force, stands for:
o: Enforcement Agency for Ganja Law Enforcement
Elite Anti-Narcotics Group for Law Enforcement
Emergency Anti-drug Group for Law and Enforcement
new.x: EAGLE = Elite Anti-Narcotics Group for Law Enforcement, headquartered at Mangalagiri.

new.s: Where is the headquarters of EAGLE, Andhra Pradesh's anti-narcotics force?
new.x: EAGLE's HQ, where the anti-drug website was launched on 26 June 2026, is at Mangalagiri.

new.s: Who heads EAGLE, the anti-narcotics force of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: EAGLE is headed by IGP Aake Ravikrishna; Vangalapudi Anitha is the Home Minister and G. Sai Prasad the Chief Secretary.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about EAGLE (June 2026):
1. Home Minister Vangalapudi Anitha launched an anti-drug website at its headquarters.
2. EAGLE Excellence Awards were given to 56 personnel.
3. Operation Chaitanyam destroyed ganja in Prakasam district.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Operation Chaitanyam was in ASR district, destroying ganja on 94.77 acres.

new.s: The headquarters of the new Polavaram district is:
new.x: Polavaram district's HQ is Rampachodavaram, not Polavaram town.

new.s: The new Markapuram district was carved out of which district?
new.x: Markapuram was carved from Prakasam; Polavaram was carved from ASR district.

new.s: For what term was Justice Tallapragada Mallikarjuna Rao appointed AP Lokayukta?
new.x: He was appointed in August 2026 for 5 years.

new.s: IFMR, which signed an MoU with Andhra Pradesh's Planning Department, is a constituent of:
new.x: IFMR is a constituent of Krea University; the MoU sets up mission cells to accelerate GSDP.

new.s: How many guiding principles (Padi Sutralu) does the Swarna Andhra @2047 Vision have?
new.x: The Padi Sutralu are 10 guiding principles; 7 is the number of basic necessities.

new.s: Which is the first of the Padi Sutralu of Swarna Andhra @2047?
new.x: Zero Poverty is the first principle; Deep Tech is the tenth.

new.s: The waste-to-energy plants under Swachh Andhra–Swarna Andhra are located at:
new.x: The plants are at Kadapa and Kurnool, with a combined 15 MW at ₹330 crore.

new.s: The AP Common Zoning Regulations, 2026 exclude which area?
new.x: The 2026 Zoning Regulations (16 to 9 categories) exclude the Capital City Area.

new.s: Under AP's Treated Wastewater Reuse Policy 2026, industries must use 20% treated water by:
new.x: Industries must use 20% treated water by 2028 and 40% by 2030.

new.s: What is the approximate planned area of the Amaravati capital?
new.x: Amaravati's planned area is about 217 sq km, developed through the Land Pooling Scheme.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the three-capital plan of Andhra Pradesh:
1. The AP Decentralisation and Inclusive Development of All Regions Act, 2020 was repealed in 2021.
2. Kurnool was proposed as the executive capital.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Only statement 1 is correct. Kurnool was proposed as the judicial capital; Visakhapatnam was to be the executive capital.

new.s: According to SRS 2024, Andhra Pradesh's total fertility rate is:
new.x: SRS 2024 puts AP's TFR at 1.4; 1.5 is the policy baseline, 1.9 India's TFR and 2.1 replacement level.

new.s: Under Andhra Pradesh's draft Population Management Policy 2026, the one-time birth incentive for the second or third child is:
new.x: The draft gives ₹25,000 at the birth of a second or third child; ₹30,000/₹40,000 are the later third/fourth child incentives.

new.s: The draft Population Management Policy 2026 of Andhra Pradesh proposes paternity leave of:
new.x: The draft proposes 2 months' paternity leave and 12 months' maternity leave for the third child.

new.s: Under the AP Fire Service (Amendment) Bill, 2026, the standard fine was raised from ₹500 to:
new.x: The standard fine rose from ₹500 to ₹10,000, and the daily default fine from ₹100 to ₹1,000.

new.s: The AP Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Bill, 2026 is mainly meant to:
new.x: The Jan Vishwas Bill replaces jail terms for minor offences with fines, on the lines of the Centre's Jan Vishwas Act, 2023.

new.s: Who took charge as Chief Secretary of Andhra Pradesh on 1 March 2026?
new.x: G. Sai Prasad (1991-batch IAS) succeeded K. Vijayanand on 1 March 2026.

new.s: Whom did G. Sai Prasad succeed as Chief Secretary of Andhra Pradesh in March 2026?
new.x: G. Sai Prasad succeeded K. Vijayanand.

new.s: Who chairs the 20-Point Programme Implementation Committee in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Lanka Dinakar chairs the 20-Point Programme Implementation Committee.

new.s: Which district has the highest number of voters in Andhra Pradesh's Gram Panchayat voter lists (2026)?
new.x: Srikakulam has the most voters and Visakhapatnam the fewest.

new.s: The RBI named which bank as lead bank for the new Polavaram and Markapuram districts?
new.x: On 10 April 2026 the RBI named Union Bank of India lead bank for both new districts.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Andhra Pradesh's new districts:
1. Polavaram district has its headquarters at Rampachodavaram.
2. Polavaram district was carved from Prakasam district.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Polavaram was carved from Alluri Sitharama Raju district; Markapuram came from Prakasam.

new.s: In the 2026 Gram Panchayat voter lists of Andhra Pradesh, which statement is correct?
new.x: Female voters (1,46,76,527) exceed male voters (1,42,29,674); total 2,89,07,633 voters in 13,329 panchayats.

new.s: How much has Andhra Pradesh allocated for NTR Bharosa pensions for 2026-27?
new.x: ₹33,485.10 crore is allocated for 2026-27 for about 62 lakh beneficiaries.

new.s: About how many beneficiaries are covered by NTR Bharosa pensions in 2026-27?
new.x: NTR Bharosa covers about 62 lakh beneficiaries.

new.s: The Jagananna Gorumudda mid-day meal scheme was renamed:
new.x: Gorumudda became Dokka Seethamma Madhyahna Badi Bhojanam; Vidya Mitra is the school-kits scheme.

new.s: Which of the following pairs of old and new scheme names is correctly matched?
o: Mana Badi Nadu-Nedu – Dokka Seethamma Madhyahna Badi Bhojanam
Jagananna Vidya Kanuka – Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan Vidya Mitra

new.s: Dr YSR Aarogyasri in Andhra Pradesh was renamed:
new.x: Aarogyasri became Dr NTR Vaidya Seva after the 2024 change of government.

new.s: In the P4 Margadarsi–Bangaru Kutumbam programme, a Margadarsi is:
new.x: Margadarsi is the mentor/donor; Bangaru Kutumbam is the beneficiary family.

new.s: Where was P4's first-anniversary event held on 30 March 2026?
new.x: It was held at Sri Padmavati Mahila Viswa Vidyalayam, Tirupati; P4 itself was launched at Amaravati.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the P4 programme:
1. It was launched on Ugadi, 30 March 2025.
2. It is a government cash-transfer scheme.
3. Its goal was restated as a poverty-free society by 2047.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. P4 is voluntary mentoring and support, not a government cash transfer.

new.s: To be eligible for Divyang Shakti free bus travel, a person must have disability of more than:
new.x: Divyang Shakti requires more than 40% disability, across 21 categories.

new.s: How many MSME parks did CM Naidu virtually launch at the MSME Growth Summit 2026?
new.x: 38 parks were launched; the goal is 175, one per Assembly constituency.

new.s: Under PM-RAHAT, cashless treatment for road accident victims is available up to:
new.x: PM-RAHAT gives cashless treatment up to ₹1.5 lakh in the Golden Hour.

new.s: Which agency is a partner of Andhra Pradesh's C-SAFE programme?
new.x: C-SAFE partners are the Universities of Liverpool and Birmingham, Fernandez Foundation and UNICEF.

new.s: Under the Gross Cost Contract model for APSRTC electric buses, the buses are owned by:
new.x: Under GCC the private operator owns and maintains the buses; the government pays per km.

new.x: SC and ST households get 100% subsidy; others up to 40%.

new.x: The MoU maps lightning hotspots for early warning.

new.x: NTR district is the first in AP with 100% CCTV coverage.
